            # Trailer rear right is b < 0 (e.g. -180 to -130)

# but if trailer rear is swung right, the trailer's rear-LEFT corner swings OUTWARD (left / into the outside wall)!
# In a right turn, the outside wall is on the LEFT! So turning the trailer rear to the right swings the front-right in, but the trailer rear-left is on the outside!
# Wait: if trailer rear swings RIGHT, trailer rear centre is at y = -0.82.
# Trailer half width = 1.7 / 2 = 0.85m.
# If trailer heading is +13.6 deg, trailer rear-left corner is at y = -0.82 + 0.85 * cos(13.6) ~ +0.01.
# And in turn 1: at 9.8m, hitch was +0.5, and rear-left corner touched!

# When we pulled forward with steer -5 deg, we stayed near the left rail.
# We need to pull forward further (at least 3.5 - 4 meters) AND steer LEFT (+15 deg) so the vehicle moves to the RIGHT side of the lane,

# Positive steer = wheels turned LEFT. Moving forward with positive steer turns vehicle LEFT.
# We want the rig to move to the RIGHT of the lane, away from the left rail! So when moving FORWARD, steer NEGATIVE (right)!
